verdict.rationale: Evidence shows client-server replication (unreal-docs-8/15), command-line startup customization including forcing 'game mode instead of full-editor mode' (unreal-docs-32), and monolithic executable build options (unreal-docs-27), which together imply server-oriented runtime configuration, but no citation explicitly documents a dedicated 'Server' build target, headless/no-rendering mode, or -nullrhi flag. Missing for 10: explicit dedicated-server target/build documentation, headless/no-render flag evidence, and any hands-on confirmation of running a server build without a GPU/rendering context.
